## Core Capabilities & Engineering Offerings

### 1. Autonomous AI Agent Development & Workflow Automation (Kolkata)
- **Overview**: Custom 24/7 autonomous agents for WhatsApp Business API and web interfaces.
- **Features**: Natural language qualification, instant appointment scheduling, CRM integration (HubSpot, Zoho, Google Sheets), private RAG knowledge base integration.
- **Business Impact**: Replaces slow manual response with instant sub-second answers; proven to increase lead capture by up to 3X.

### 2. Custom Software & Enterprise SaaS Development
- **Overview**: Bespoke full-stack software built with Next.js 15, React, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, and Supabase.
- **Features**: Bank-grade Role-Based Access Control (RBAC), multi-tenant SaaS architecture, AES-256 encrypted data stores, microservice & REST/GraphQL APIs.
- **Delivery**: 3–6 Weeks Agile Sprints.

### 3. Local Business Growth Package
- **Overview**: High-speed conversion landing page paired with local Google Maps (GMB) #1 ranking dominance.

- **Delivery**: 10–14 Days.
